core.text: Commit provisionally to H1: delayed borrower completion is the main working account. Transient short counts and their closing-time concentration fit this hypothesis, but unwatched, unidentified mat arrivals establish neither origin nor cause. The fourth shortage remains unresolved.

Adopt direct-to-own-tray return as the candidate operating construction: retain numbered open trays and self-service shelf return, instruct borrowers to put every counter into their own tray, and retain the full five-minute use allowance. This changes the communal reconciliation path; its benefit is untested.

Use only the additional twenty-minute block and two volunteers. Prospectively select sequential returns, with at most one tray inspected. One volunteer watches placement and subsequent transfers in seconds; the other independently records selected checkout and initial return counts. Record later tray and mat counts at one, three, and five minutes when attention and block time permit, plus waiting borrowers and active loans. Record disagreements before recounting; do not assume either count correct.

Verify five complete twelve-counter kits and separately account for the remaining eleven counters. Issue only complete kits. Log every replenishment separately from evidence of borrower return. Record unresolved shortages at five minutes, or truncated observation when the block ends; neither qualifies as successful reconciliation. Five complete circulating kits cannot guarantee five simultaneously ready shelf kits during active loans.

residue.text: H2 remains a rival: unrelated borrower traffic or volunteer transfers may produce apparent recovery. An unwatched loose counter remains unattributed even if it restores twelve.
H3 remains possible because historical counts lacked independent checks. New disagreement without a transfer supports counting uncertainty; agreement can still share error.
A small block may contain no watched anomaly. Changed attention and unspecified demand limit causal inference; unresolved counter location and closing-time concentration remain unknown.

tension.account_a: H1 for a selected event: the corresponding borrower physically supplies the final counter after tray placement.
tension.account_b: Pure H2 for that event: the corresponding borrower supplies no late counter; recovery comes from another loan or volunteer redistribution.
tension.prediction_a: Following independently agreed eleven, a watched corresponding borrower arrival precedes the rise to twelve without volunteer supplementation.
tension.prediction_b: No corresponding borrower arrival occurs; the rise follows a watched unrelated transfer. Unwatched recovery or absence of shortages separates neither account.
